Voting Record — House 119th Congress, 2nd session curated seed (roll calls 224-283,
2026-06-23 → 2026-07-23). Pulled from the Congress.gov API through the FIXED normalizer
(netlify/lib/vr-normalize.ts) with the date-ordered `recent: true` list paging added in
netlify/lib/vr-ingest.ts, then written here verbatim. Every roll call keeps its
api.congress.gov sourceUrl; no vote is invented or edited.

memberVotes is filtered to the db/vr-member-map.json roster (unmapped bioguide IDs are
skipped, never guessed) — the same filter the runtime ingest applies. `isParty` was
computed from the FULL chamber tally at pull time, and `partyTotals` (all 431 members,
by party) is retained so that flag can be re-derived and audited from this file alone.

Consumed by scripts/vr-gen-house-migration.mjs, which emits the additive + idempotent
deploy-time migration. Regenerate by re-running the pull:
  node scripts/vr-ingest.mjs run house 119 20 --recent --offset=0   (then 20, then 40)
